tone.notes: Fast, curious and a little cheeky; the catchphrase lands once in the fly-in; the 'the ball is the lid' payoff is clear for a general audience.

banned_topics.notes: An everyday object and how it works; nothing near the banned list.

visuals.notes: Explode view separates barrel, ink tube and tip clearly; every label fits its box and points at the right part; captions never touch each other; headlines stay inside the safe area.

character.notes: Pip matches the model (chrome orb, one big eye, antenna, LED mouth) and the mouth follows the voice; expressions fit the lines.

learnings: Keep callout labels short (≤ 14 characters) — longer ones get auto-shrunk and read small on a phone.
The fly-in to the tip followed by a focus on the ball explains 'how it works' better than labels alone; reuse fly-in → focus for the key part.
A one-line physical payoff ('the ball is the lid') works as the ending; aim for one per object.
